 Home State News Breakfast Products Distributed in Arkansas Recalled Over Possible Listeria Contamination Breakfast Products Distributed in Arkansas Recalled Over Possible Listeria Contamination
 Thu, November 19, 2026 by News Room 
 SHARE NOW 
 Two ready-to-eat breakfast products distributed in Arkansas have been recalled over concerns that biscuits used in the meals may be contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes, a bacterium that can cause serious illness.
 Fresh & Ready Foods expanded its recall Tuesday, November 17th, to include breakfast sandwiches and biscuit-and-gravy meals distributed in Arkansas and several other Southern states.
 The affected meals were distributed through refrigerated vending machines, employee break rooms, Grab & Go coolers, and workplace micro-markets, instead of traditional grocery store distribution.
 The expanded recall involves two products manufactured at the company’s Longview, Texas, facility and distributed between October 15th and November 11th.
 The affected products include:
 Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwich: 5.7-ounce packages with SKU 3100048 and Fresh Thru dates ranging from November 12th through November 22nd.
 Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy: 9.5-ounce packages with SKU 90013 and expiration dates ranging from November 12th through November 18th.
 Both products contain biscuits supplied by C.H. Guenther & Son, which recalled certain biscuit products because of possible Listeria contamination.
 The U.S. Department of Agriculture’s Food Safety and Inspection Service issued a public health alert Saturday, November 14th, concerning the biscuit-and-gravy meals. Fresh & Ready Foods subsequently expanded its voluntary recall to include the affected products distributed across Arkansas and neighboring states.
 The company’s original recall, announced November 8th, involved a different-sized breakfast sandwich distributed in Oregon and Washington. The November 17th expansion added the products manufactured in Texas, including those distributed in Arkansas.
 Although Arkansas is among the states where the products were distributed, federal recall notices do not identify which Arkansas counties, employers, or vending locations received them. Distribution to Jefferson County or other Southeast Arkansas communities has not been confirmed.
 Listeria infection can cause fever, muscle aches, headaches, stiffness, nausea, abdominal pain, and diarrhea. More serious infections can occur, particularly among pregnant women, newborns, older adults, and people with weakened immune systems.
 No illnesses had been reported in connection with the recalled products as of the company’s expanded recall announcement.
 Consumers who purchased either product are advised not to eat it and to discard it. Because some affected sandwiches carry Fresh Thru dates extending through November 22nd, consumers should check any products they may still have in refrigerators or workplace food storage areas.
 Anyone with questions about the recall or seeking a refund can contact Fresh & Ready Foods at 1-855-424-8390, Monday through Friday, from 8 a.m. to 6 p.m. Eastern Time, or email [email protected] .
 Additional information, including photographs of the recalled packaging, is available through the FDA’s official recall announcement.
